response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering experience, a CS degree, and genuine high-scale exposure (low-latency microservices handling millions of requests/second at Sociomantic/dunnhumby), plus current work on AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling that maps to the 'AI-first' and 'accelerate engineering velocity' preferences. However, the resume shows no evidence of the core domain this role is built around: experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, statistical analysis, or growth measurement. Scope is also a concern — the roles described are largely individual or small-team contributions at startups/SMEs rather than Principal/IC6-level cross-org initiatives with multi-workstream leadership and stakeholder alignment. Worth an exploratory screen to probe scale of influence and any unlisted data/experimentation work, but he is not an obvious fit as presented.
strengths: 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded; strong fundamentals (C/C++, Java, C#, TS, D)
Proven high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems work at ad-tech scale
Systemic/tooling mindset: built test runners, libraries, CI/CD, MCP generators, and teaches widely
concerns: No demonstrated experimentation, A/B testing, or feature-flighting platform experience
No telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical/bias-detection analysis background
Scope and cross-org technical leadership appear below Principal/IC6 expectations

key_factors.factor: Depth and breadth of engineering experience
Principal-level scope and cross-team influence not evidenced
